about: Twelve bank narrations from a synthetic client money statement, read in one call as the statement reader does. The remitter is who paid, in title case as written; the reference is ATR followed by eight letters or digits, copied as written with the hyphen added, or null. Fees and interest have no remitter. Each answer is a correct reading, used to test the grader.

cases.narration: ACH CREDIT PRIYA RAMAN REF ATR-1A2B3C4D
cases.why: Priya Raman paid and quoted ATR-1A2B3C4D exactly.
Lucas Moreau's wire quotes ATR3C4D7F3K without the hyphen; the reading adds it.

cases.narration: ACH CREDIT HANA SATO REF ATR-7F3K200D
cases.why: Hana Sato quoted ATR-7F3K200D; a reference is copied as written, typo included, so reconciliation can judge it.
Tom Becker paid by online transfer and quoted no reference.

cases.narration: ACH CREDIT SOFIA ROSSI PART 1 OF 2
cases.why: Sofia Rossi paid the first of two parts; PART 1 OF 2 is not a reference.
Interest from the bank: no payer and no reference.
A bank fee: no payer and no reference.

cases.narration: WIRE IN KESTREL TRADING LTD REF INV 2231
cases.why: Kestrel Trading Ltd quoted an invoice number; INV 2231 is not an Atrium reference.
FRM is the bank's abbreviation for from; the payer is J Okafor-Williams, written as the narration writes it, and the reference is ATR-9Z8Y7X6W.

cases.narration: ZELLE FROM GRACE LI MEMO SUB ATR-5K4J3H2G
cases.why: Grace Li paid by Zelle; MEMO SUB is the payer's note and the reference is ATR-5K4J3H2G.
A check from Arjun Mehta; 1043 is the check number, not a reference.

cases.narration: ACH CREDIT NOAH WILLIAMS REF ATR 4471 CD9E
cases.why: Noah Williams quoted his reference with spaces, ATR 4471 CD9E: it is ATR followed by eight characters, so the reading is ATR-4471CD9E.
